beats.summary: Dwight discusses his survival stock and food expiration.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: I have the best survival stock shelter in north eastern Pennsylvania.
It's nice not to have to plan my meals.

beats.summary: Todd Packer returns to the office, causing mixed reactions.

evidence.snippet: Todd Packer: I really though I was becoming too much of a womanizer.
Michael: Still not seeing the problem here.

beats.summary: Michael introduces Todd Packer to Holly, indicating a positive view of Packer's return.
Michael announces Todd Packer as a permanent salesman, prompting reactions from staff.
Dwight objects to moving desks for Packer, leading to humorous interactions.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: I don't wanna move desks!
Michael: Don't be a baby! Okay! There it is.

beats.summary: Holly defends her decision to hire Packer despite staff concerns.

evidence.snippet: Holly: Okay, look. We can't fire someone because we don't like him.
